name: Wildpack Beverage Inc.
summary: Wildpack Beverage Inc. specializes in the filling and aesthetic enhancement of beverage cans. The company provides a comprehensive suite of services, including can sleeving and labeling, co-packing for various beverages, custom can packaging solutions, and private label offerings, alongside warehousing facilities. Additionally, Wildpack actively procures and brokers essential packaging components such as aluminum cans, can ends, cartons, trays, and other tertiary packaging materials. Wildpack Beverage Inc. operates from its headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.
